Taught Georgia history/government and American history for the Jackson County Board of Education; also worked as a clerk at McDonald Ace Hardware and as clerk/assistant manager with the W. T. TOMMY BENTON.record: Chaired the House Human Relations and Aging Committee (2013-2017) and the House Retirement Committee (2019-2020); other committees included Education, Rules, Transportation and Appropriations (2021-2022). In January 2016 he told the Atlanta Journal-Constitution that the Ku Klux Klan 'was not so much a racist thing but a vigilante thing to keep law and order' and 'made a lot of people straighten up' (as reported by Mother Jones); after criticism he withdrew his name from his Confederate-related bills, which Speaker David Ralston welcomed (AP, Feb. 1, 2016).
